summary: Solomon Islands’ mixed pledges combine forest restoration, conservation and agricultural mitigation. Restoration targets are 8,000 ha of new sustainable terrestrial forest and 4,000 ha of mangrove forest; the former is about 0.3% of current 26,547 km² forest area and the latter about 0.14% of total land area. Fully implemented afforestation and reforestation actions are expected to add up to 200 ktCO2e of carbon removal in 2035, while a related metric reports 200.0 ktCO2/yr for forest removals/sequestration. Solomon Islands also intends sustainable logging and protection of forest above the 400-meter contour. Conservation targets are at least 20% of terrestrial and inland waters and 15% of coastal and marine areas. Agriculture includes four farm-scale biogas units, a planned 2.4 ktCO2e biogas impact and a 2.4 ktCO2e/yr livestock-mitigation metric, with implementation still requiring support.

targets.context: ≈0.14% of total land area; mangrove extent is not separately mapped
Current agriculture covers 358 km², but the pledge is a unit count rather than an area target.
